about.your_music_your_cloud_nfor:
Your music, your cloud.
For you and your whole family – at home, on the go, on every device.
about.nati_is_a_music_player: Nati is a music player with its own home cloud. Your music stays with you – on your computer or NAS – not on someone else's servers. No ads, no subscription, no tracking.
about.everyone_at_home_has_their: Everyone at home has their own account: their own playlists, favourites and listening history.

about.library_accounts_and_playlists_liv: Library, accounts and playlists live on your server. You decide who has access.

support.nati_is_free_and_will: Nati is free and will stay that way – no ads, no subscription and no paid features. It is made after hours, out of love for music. If you find it useful, you can buy the author a coffee. Every contribution is voluntary and unlocks nothing – it simply helps keep the app growing.

cloud.the_server_shut_down_to:
The server shut down to apply the change, but did not start again by itself – it was probably started manually. Nothing was lost: the change will be applied on the next start.

Start the server:
• on this computer: ./uruchom.sh (or ./uruchom.sh --serwer – server only),
• in Docker: docker compose up -d (or restart the container),
• on a NAS: restart the Nati app / container.

Then connect to the cloud again.

cloud.a_backup_contains_accounts_playlis: A backup contains accounts, playlists, favourites, history, covers and images, lyrics and library changes. It does not contain your music folder – you have that on your own disk. It also contains password hashes and the sign-in key, so keep it safe.
cloud.1_create_a_backup_and:
1. Create a backup and download it to this computer.
2. On the new server (e.g. a new NAS) start Nati and copy your music folder there – with the same subfolder layout.
3. Connect to the new server, create a temporary administrator account, come here, upload the backup and restore it.

Music paths are rewritten to the new ones, so playlists, favourites and history stay. Without the app: copy the backup file to the data/backups folder of the new server.
cloud.deletes_everything_accounts_playli: Deletes everything: accounts, playlists, favourites, history, covers, trash and cache. The server starts like new. Your music folder and backups stay.
cloud.all_accounts_yours_too_playlists:
All accounts (yours too), playlists, favourites, history, covers, lyrics, trash and cache will be deleted. This cannot be undone – unless you have a backup.

Your music folder will not be changed, and backups stay on the server.
